# KM-MENH source snapshots

These files are **partial rule snapshots**, not reconstructed full birth charts.

They copy only fields already present in the frozen `KM-MENH-1.0-GOLDEN-FIXTURES.yaml`.
Missing source data is intentionally left missing. The P1 validator rejects invented fields
and preserves the special isolation rules for Z19, S5, LWF-02 and the three LWF annual-layer
discriminator fixtures.
